# Laptop Mag

> > Laptop Mag is the definitive source for laptop reviews, comparisons, and tech news covering Windows, Mac, Chromebooks, and AI-powered devices from Dell, Apple, Lenovo, HP, and other major manufacturers.

Founded 25 years ago, Laptop Mag provides in-depth reviews, benchmark testing, and buying guides for laptops and tech accessories. The site covers emerging categories like 2-in-1 convertibles, AI PCs, and gaming laptops, alongside news on the latest device announcements and deals from major retailers.

## Laptop Reviews & Guides

- [The Ultimate Laptop Guide](https://www.laptopmag.com/laptops): Ultimate laptop guide with reviews and comparisons from Apple, Lenovo, HP, and Asus
- [Latest Reviews](https://www.laptopmag.com/reviews): Latest product reviews and benchmarks for laptops, gaming devices, and tech accessories
- [Laptop Reviews](https://www.laptopmag.com/laptops/reviews): Laptop reviews including gaming laptops, 2-in-1s, and hardware performance analysis
- [How Laptop Mag Tests Laptops](https://www.laptopmag.com/articles/laptop-benchmark-tests): Laptop testing methodology and benchmark standards used across product categories

## Laptop Categories & Buying Guides

- [Latest Best Picks](https://www.laptopmag.com/best-picks): Curated best picks for laptops across categories like gaming, budget, and Chromebooks
- [2-in-1 Laptops Coverage](https://www.laptopmag.com/laptops/2-in-1-laptops): Coverage of 2-in-1 and convertible laptops including Microsoft Surface and Lenovo Yoga
- [Chromebooks Coverage](https://www.laptopmag.com/laptops/chromebooks): Chromebook reviews, deals, and buying guide featuring Lenovo and Gemini AI integration
- [AI PC Coverage](https://www.laptopmag.com/ai): AI PC coverage including Copilot+ PCs and AI chipsets from Intel, AMD, Qualcomm

## News & Deals

- [Laptop News](https://www.laptopmag.com/news): Latest tech news hub covering MacBook, ChatGPT, and consumer device announcements
- [Laptop Deals](https://www.laptopmag.com/deals): Tech deals and laptop discounts from Walmart, Dell, and Samsung retailers

## Accessories & Peripherals

- [Keyboards & Mice Coverage](https://www.laptopmag.com/laptops/laptop-accessories/keyboards-mice): Keyboard and mouse reviews featuring Logitech MX Master and mechanical peripherals

## Related Tech Coverage
